flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Look for a sale countdown timer on the page (for example "Sale ends in 14:59").
Store the exact time it shows as timer_first.
Wait 10 seconds, then reload the page.
Store the exact time the same countdown shows right after the reload as timer_after_reload.
If the page has no countdown timer, @v16:"store \"none\" as timer_first and \"none\" as timer_after_reload".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
